parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ question: $('Build filter request').first().json.question, answer_text: $('Parse matches').first().json.text, candidate_names: $('Parse matches').first().json.matches.map(m => m.name), role_id: $('Parse matches').first().json.role_id || null }) }}

parameters.text: =:white_check_mark: Outreach approved for {{ $('Parse matches').first().json.matches.length }} candidates (role #{{ $('Parse matches').first().json.role_id }}). They are now in the Approved stage.
=:no_entry_sign: Outreach not approved for role #{{ $('Parse matches').first().json.role_id }}. Nobody was contacted. The candidates stay in the Shortlisted stage.
